first_missing_criterion: Record-level official/public British National Grid physical building-footprint Polygon coordinates for the University of Exeter Forum, with explicit Forum/building-use identity bound to the same feature. The University of Exeter Digital Estate Team public Roof Access Safety Web App describes detailed building-specific roof data and interactive university rooftop layers across Streatham and St Luke's campuses, but the selected no-login item surface did not expose an individual Forum feature payload and did not establish that any rooftop polygon represents the building's physical ground footprint; therefore no individual building record was accepted.
